items.title: Pay ergotherapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: This is a private payment deadline set by the provider, counted under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB. Start event: Rechnungsdatum = 18.11.2026; this day is not counted. Period = 21 days, so the period ends 21 days after 18.11.2026, i.e. on 09.12.2026 (18.11 → 30.11 is 12 days, remaining 9 days run into December → 9 December 2026). 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW (the payer's Land, relevant for payments under §§ 269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
